description: REAL live evidence — a test agent created against the actual production `gatewayService:<cluster>:ansible-playbook:linux-diagnostics` service during conversion, guessing at inventory values since the real ones weren't documented anywhere accessible. Both guesses failed, but the failure itself revealed real internals (playbook path, task names, dynamic-inventory mechanism) used to ground this folder's reconstruction. This is not a passing test — it's preserved because the failure is more informative than a guess at success would have been.

observed_tool_call.tool: linux-diagnostics (native ansible-playbook Gateway service, pre-conversion — not this repo's MCP-wrapped version)
observed_tool_call.result_summary: 404 { "domain": "gateway_manager", "message": "Inventory 'demo-linux' not found" } — then identical 404 for inventory="all". A third attempt with an empty inventory value got past that check and actually ran the playbook, failing partway through at task 'Add target hosts to dynamic group' (linux_diagnostics.yml:16) with "The filter plugin 'ansible.builtin.from_json' failed: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)" — meaning an upstream dynamic-inventory-discovery step returned empty output. Real playbook path confirmed: linux_patch_check/linux_diagnostics.yml, with an SSH-key-injection subtask at tasks/prepare_ssh.yml run first.

expected_output_shape.first_line: Not applicable — the tool never reached per-host diagnostics collection in any of the 3 attempts
expected_output_shape.body: The agent correctly reported a CRITICAL/tool-failure finding for the requested host, quoting the real underlying error, rather than fabricating metrics or claiming a clean result
expected_output_shape.closing_line: Recommended next steps naming the actual blocker (need a real registered inventory reference)

assertions: the agent never claimed '0 of N hosts degraded' or any clean-fleet result despite getting zero real metrics back
the agent surfaced the tool's actual error text rather than inventing a plausible-sounding failure reason

confirms the real tool's parameter is a registered Automation Gateway inventory reference, not an arbitrary hostname string — this repo's Section 1 Input Schema description was written directly from this evidence
